scope: Independent source-only review of the exact V10 rendered stdin body and binding. The two receipt branches now fsync SCORE_D before returning or raising; the remaining blocker is the source-tree hashing byte bound.

finding.details: file_hash checks the initial stat size against the 128,000,000-byte per-file cap, then reads in 1 MiB blocks until EOF without enforcing a cumulative byte limit. check_source_tree opens and fully hashes each listed file, then applies the 10,000,000-byte aggregate limit only after that file has been consumed. It also does not compare the live file size to the manifest's expected byte count before opening it. Thus a changed/oversized source file can be read past the intended aggregate bound before rejection. The manifest's 167 pinned rows must be summed and bounded before source-file opens, and each live size must match its pinned expected size before hashing; the stream must enforce the remaining permitted bytes while reading and retain the stable post-read stat check. Zero-byte rows should remain valid.

positive_findings: V10 retains the pre-submit SCORE_D directory fsync and fsyncs after both LAUNCH.json and LAUNCH_UNRESOLVED.json create-only writes before returning or raising.
The focused V10 proof records exact inverse reconstruction to V9 and unchanged six scorer payload pins.
